description: Defines the CmduPeer class used for sending, forwarding, and receiving CMDU messages over network sockets, including handler types and related methods.

classes.name: CmduPeer
classes.description: A class for handling CMDU message transmission and reception over network sockets, including forwarding and processing received messages.

methods.name: CmduPeer
methods.description: Constructor initializing parser and serializer for CMDU messages.

methods.name: send_cmdu
methods.description: Serializes and sends a CMDU message over a socket connection.

methods.name: forward_cmdu
methods.description: Forwards a received CMDU message to another socket connection, with routing info.

methods.name: receive_cmdus
methods.description: Reads data from socket, parses CMDU messages, and invokes handler for each received message.
